original_batch.notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable editorial rubric on 2026-08-25. docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md were read before grading. ALFIE-oriented search, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, Yamamoto schedule sources, and current Japanese jazz sources produced no new unrecorded Tsuyoshi Yamamoto performance. Benny Sings' December 11 WWW X date clears RADAR admission because it is his first Japan performance in three years and a one-night Tokyo return centered on his new album 22 Durnham Dew. Priority A is deliberate: the current evidence supports a distinctive, current groove/songwriting date worth knowing about, but not an unusually rare lineup, premiere, farewell, or other context that warrants active-priority or scarcity language.

events.subtitle: 2026 Tour — 22 Durnham Dew
events.factual_description: WWW X presents Benny Sings in Shibuya on Friday, December 11, 2026, with doors at 6:00 PM and the performance starting at 7:00 PM. The venue describes it as his first Japan performance since 2023 and a one-night Tokyo show tied to the new album 22 Durnham Dew. Benny Sings' official live calendar independently lists the December 11 Tokyo date at WWW X. The venue lists advance admission at ¥7,800 plus drink charge and links to eplus as authorized ticketing.

enrichment.note: Exact WWW X event page, showtime, authorized eplus destination, artist tour confirmation, and exact Apple Music album page are verified. Touring personnel beyond Benny Sings have not been announced and were not inferred.

sources.note: Official venue page confirms December 11, 2026, doors 6:00 PM / start 7:00 PM, WWW X, one-night Japan framing, first Japan performance since 2023, advance price, and authorized eplus ticketing.
Official artist live calendar independently confirms December 11, 2026 in Tokyo at WWW X.
Exact Apple Music pre-release page for Benny Sings' 2026 album 22 Durnham Dew.

provenance.note: Date, venue, doors/start time, one-night Japan framing and ticketing were verified directly from WWW X; the artist's official live calendar independently confirms the Tokyo date; the exact new-album page was verified on Apple Music. Repository search found no existing Benny Sings / WWW X December 11, 2026 RADAR record. No touring sidemen, special guests, repertoire, or unannounced production details were inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Benny Sings earns a RADAR slot less through virtuoso display than through an unusually recognizable sense of pocket and miniature arrangement: soft soul, R&B, pop craft and beat-minded production compressed into songs that sound deceptively easy. This Tokyo return has a real current center because it arrives with 22 Durnham Dew rather than as a catalog stop, and WWW X is a useful scale for hearing whether those tightly built studio grooves open up onstage. The one-night return after three years adds context without turning the show into a scarcity event.
en.trip_verdict: Keep it on the board if December 11 is open in Tokyo. It is a distinctive groove-and-songwriting night and a good contrast to the heavier jazz-master thread, but I would fit it around rarer instrumental encounters, premieres, reunions or one-off contexts rather than move one of those to make room.

es.why_it_matters: Benny Sings entra al RADAR menos por una exhibición de virtuosismo que por una manera muy reconocible de construir pocket y arreglos en miniatura: soul suave, R&B, oficio pop y lógica de beat comprimidos en canciones que parecen sencillas hasta que uno escucha cómo están armadas. Este regreso a Tokio tiene un centro actual porque llega con 22 Durnham Dew y no como una parada de catálogo, y WWW X tiene una escala interesante para escuchar qué pasa cuando esos grooves tan trabajados en estudio se abren en vivo. Que sea una sola noche y su primera visita en tres años le da contexto sin convertirla artificialmente en una fecha escasa.
es.trip_verdict: La tendría en el tablero si el 11 de diciembre está libre en Tokio. Es una noche distinta de groove y composición y un buen contrapunto al hilo de maestros de jazz, pero la acomodaría alrededor de encuentros instrumentales más raros, estrenos, reuniones o contextos realmente de una sola oportunidad en vez de desplazar uno de esos conciertos para hacerle espacio.
